# EyesProtector
> Mac free; unlock iPhone/iPad once. Look-away reminders, dual-pair commute prompts, Smart Pause. Not a medical device.

# Verde Player
> A silky-smooth offline music player for iPhone and iPad. One of the most fluid experiences closest to Apple Music's native app. Tiny install size under 10 MB. Import FLAC, MP3, AAC and more. No ads, no account, no tracking.
- [English Landing](verde/en/): Marketing homepage
